instruction: Open 'character.png' in GIMP and increase the saturation of the image, then export it as 'character_saturated.png'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening character.png in GIMP, increasing saturation (Colors > Hue-Saturation), and exporting as character_saturated.png. Evaluator checks that the result has at least 10 units higher average saturation than the original by converting to HSV and comparing saturation channels.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts saturation values by converting images to HSV and comparing saturation channels
Metric correctly compares result['is_increased'] with expected['is_increased']
10-unit threshold prevents false negatives from minor rounding errors
Evaluator will correctly fail (return 0.0) if export file doesn't exist, as getter returns None and metric handles this case
Logic correctly verifies the main requirement: saturation was increased
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider explicitly checking file existence before processing to provide clearer error messages (currently implicit via None return)
Document the 10-unit threshold in metadata or expected rules to clarify why this specific value was chosen
Consider making the threshold configurable via expected rules rather than hardcoded in getter
